phases.label: Right and left forward lunge and return

interpretation: Follow explicit alternating forward lunge-and-return instructions, despite the back-and-forth title. Use a complete right/left cycle in5s with deliberate foot placement, modest knee depth and supported landing. Hands are unspecified: choose relaxed counterbalance arms. Rear heel lift may be declared; no planted-foot drift or knee/hip collapse. All ranges and timings are authored demonstration choices; no clinical or measured activation claim.
